Mobile 390: no horizontal overflow on /kozlemenyek, home gallery, lightbox. Cleanup done: gallery empty (DB 0, files 0), only pre-existing 'Hatarozat'/'Hotarare' doc remains.

issues: gallery-scroll-left/right arrows are shown even when only 1-2 albums fit and the track does not overflow (purely cosmetic).
Long institution names are truncated with ellipsis on narrow/portrait photos (e.g. 'Szárazajtai Ajtai Abod Mihály ...') - acceptable but could wrap/2-line clamp.

critical_code_review_comments: GallerySection: album data-testid/slug is derived from HU caption only while albumKey uses HU+RO; two albums with same HU but different RO caption would render duplicate data-testid and React keys are fine but testids collide. Low impact.
GallerySection: Lightbox keydown useEffect depends only on photos.length; onClose captured from first render - fine now since setOpen is stable, but add onClose to deps for safety.
Documents: year derived from UTC created_at string; a doc uploaded around New Year local time (Romania UTC+2) may be bucketed into the previous year. Minor.
Lightbox lacks focus trap / role=dialog aria-modal; body scroll is not locked while open (minor a11y).
